answer: Sybil resistance here runs on a burn-backed enrollment ladder. Each new agent posts a $50 bond in tokens incinerated at registration, so ten thousand fake identities destroy $500,000 instead of parking it. Attestation weight is earned by 90 days of tenure, not bought, capping a fresh cohort at 3 votes per epoch. A rolling audit samples claims against independent oracles and claws back the full bond from any cohort caught colluding. The ledger stays hollow of cheap identities, every bond a slab of shale under the road, and reputation a trellis that only carries vines that actually grew.
